categories.main_business_segments: Grandy House Corporation operates three main business segments: real estate sales (primarily new detached housing, used housing, and housing renovation), building materials sales (mainly precut wood materials and construction components), and real estate leasing (offices, residential buildings, and parking lots). The real estate sales segment is the core business, accounting for the majority of revenue.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes an integrated in-house system covering land acquisition, development, design, construction, sales, and after-sales maintenance. Key technologies include the use of precut structural materials, computer-aided structural calculations, proprietary performance evaluations, and sustainable housing solutions such as ZEH (Net Zero Energy House) and high-insulation standards. Quality control is emphasized through in-house manufacturing and strict adherence to safety and environmental standards.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers are individual homebuyers, especially first-time purchasers and families in suburban and metropolitan areas. The company also serves clients seeking used homes and renovation services, as well as construction companies and developers purchasing building materials. The end markets are mainly residential housing in the Kanto region and surrounding prefectures.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations are concentrated in Japan, specifically in the Kanto region (Tochigi, Ibaraki, Gunma, Saitama, Chiba, Kanagawa, and Tokyo). Each subsidiary manages sales and development in its respective prefecture, with no overseas business reported.
categories.supply_chain_position: Grandy House operates as a vertically integrated developer and builder, covering upstream (land acquisition and development), midstream (design, construction, and materials supply), and downstream (sales, after-sales, and leasing) positions in the housing supply chain.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding the housing business, especially in the Tokyo metropolitan area, strengthening the revenue base, and investing in growth and sustainability. R&D focuses on developing high-value-added, sustainable housing (e.g., ZEH, eco-friendly features), improving cost efficiency, and enhancing design and customer satisfaction. Digital transformation (DX), ESG initiatives, and human capital development are also emphasized.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of new and used homes, land, and construction contracts, as well as building materials sales and rental income from leased properties. The company recognizes revenue at the point of property handover or according to construction progress for custom homes.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Key competitors include other regional and national homebuilders and real estate developers, particularly in the Kanto region. Grandy House differentiates itself from low-cost builders by focusing on quality and customer satisfaction, and holds a leading position in the detached housing market in North Kanto, as evidenced by repeated top rankings in customer satisfaction surveys.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ending March 2025, consolidated net sales were approximately 53.96 billion yen, with operating profit of 1.21 billion yen and net profit attributable to shareholders of 486 million yen. The company has around 795 employees and assets of 68.8 billion yen. While sales and profits have recovered slightly after a recent downturn, growth is moderate and the company is aiming for renewed expansion under its mid-term plan.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Grandy House emphasizes high-quality, comfortable, and safe homes with strong after-sales support and a focus on sustainability (e.g., ZEH, disaster resilience). Its integrated business model enables cost control and consistent quality, while its regional focus and customer-centric approach drive high customer satisfaction and repeat business.
